HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Giant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow larger and produce slightly more.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Dwarf
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants grow smaller and produce slightly less.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Humongous
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants need tree-like spacing, grow enormously, and multiply their yield.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Cold-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants tolerate colder growing temperatures.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Cold-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants need warmer conditions before they grow well.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Heat-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants tolerate hotter growing temperatures.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Heat-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants stop growing in heat sooner.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Disease-Resistant
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants are less likely to accept blight.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Disease-Vulnerable
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants accept blight more readily and suffer extra blight damage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: High-Yield
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants produce more at harvest and grow more densely.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Low-Yield
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants produce less at harvest and grow more sparsely.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants require less growing skill to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants require more growing skill to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy Sow
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take less work to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult Sow
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take more work to sow.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Easy Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take less work to harvest.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Difficult Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants take more work to harvest.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants require a delivered resource before growth begins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Mulch)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, a grower must deliver five wood as mulch before growth begins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Hay)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, a grower must deliver eight hay as organic fertilizer before growth begins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resource-Dependent (Fungus)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: After sowing, a grower must deliver five raw fungus as fertilizer before growth begins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Perennial
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants become dormant in cold weather, continue at 1% growth, and recover when warmth returns.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Self-Seeding
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: At maturity, plants sow one adjacent valid empty cell.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Delicate
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have fewer hit points and a taller, thinner habit.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Robust
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have more hit points and a squat, broad habit.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Very Delicate
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have very few hit points and take damage whenever a pawn or animal walks over them.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Forage
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wild animals find the standing plant especially nutritious and attractive.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Fish-Habitat
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Mature plants near fishing water increase fishing yield.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Aquatic Forage
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Fish feed on these aquatic plants, reducing crop yield.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Aquatic
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants can only be cultivated in aquatic growing zones.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Desert
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants can only be cultivated in sandy growing zones.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Synergy
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants gain a selected stat bonus when grown near a selected plant type.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Byproduct
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvesting may also produce a configurable secondary product.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Byproduct (Hay)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvesting may also produce a small amount of hay.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants develop a resin with a configurable contact effect.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Joyresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Yellow resin gives handlers a short mood boost after sowing or harvesting.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Painresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Black resin causes temporary pain when handled.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Burnresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Red resin can burn handlers.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Resinous (Toxresin)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Green resin causes toxic buildup when handled.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Thorny
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants may scratch a harvester's hand.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Beautiful
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants have a soft golden radiance and improve surrounding beauty.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ugly
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Plants emit a conspicuous unhealthy gloom and reduce surrounding beauty.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Produce Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's produce and harvested produce layers.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Leaf Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's leaf layer.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Stem Color
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Changes the color of the plant's stem layer.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Nutritious (+%)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvested produce provides a generated percentage of additional nutrition.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Highly Medicinal
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Harvested medicine has 15% greater medical potency.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Compound
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Produce develops a compound with an effect when eaten raw or as an ingredient in prepared food.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Compound (Joycompound)
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Produce contains a pleasant compound that gives a temporary mood boost when eaten raw or in prepared food.
